vulnerability_analysis: The TetherToken contract has a deprecate function that allows the owner to set an upgradedAddress. When deprecated is true, all token operations are delegated to the upgraded contract via the UpgradedStandardToken interface. The owner can set any address as the upgraded contract, including a malicious one that implements the interface but steals funds instead of performing legitimate operations.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank. 2. Deploy a malicious upgrade contract that implements UpgradedStandardToken interface with functions that transfer funds to attacker. 3. Call deprecate() on TetherToken with the malicious contract address. 4. Use the malicious contract's functions to transfer all tokens from large holders to attacker.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.startPrank() to impersonate the current owner. 2. Deploy MaliciousUpgrade contract. 3. Call TetherToken.deprecate(maliciousUpgrade). 4. Use MaliciousUpgrade.transferByLegacy() to transfer tokens from victim addresses to attacker. 5. Verify attacker balance increased.
